Nurses see what policy can't.
For 125 years, J&J has backed nurses. Now we're bringing them
into the policy conversation that shapes health care in America.
4.5 million. The nurse shortage the world faces by 2030. Nurses make up nearly six in ten health workers worldwide, the largest share of the health care workforce. Just 1 in 100 hospital board seats are held by a nurse. That's the gap this campaign exists to close.
